newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Regulator no to Telecel GSM frequencies.
newsitem.headline: Regulator no to Telecel GSM frequencies.

text.p: The Portugal Communications Institute (ICP), a regulatory body, has declined a request by mobile phone operator Telecel for additional GSM (global system for mobile telecommunications) frequencies, Telecel said.

"The request for additional GSM frequencies was declined by the ICP, who argued that 'the GSM frequencies will be kept for the third operator in an effort to make available resources equal for each competitor,'" a statement said.
A competition for a third mobile phone operator in Portugal is expected to be launched later this year. The two current operators are Telecel and TMN, a unit of Portugal Telecom .

"Telecel regrets this decision (by the ICP), believing that the actual and potential growth of its customer base fully justified its request for additional GSM and DCS frequencies," the statement said.
"Telecel believes that the current operators should not be administratively restrained in their growth opportunities," it added.
Telecel shares stood unchanged at 14,499 escudos in volume of 57,640 shares at 1514 GMT.
